theme: A clear calendar — the only pressure is a few travel clocks winding down.
greeting: Not a meeting in sight today, Dan, so the day is genuinely yours. What's live is a cluster of holiday-travel bookings where the booking windows are starting to close.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority Todoist task, overdue since Sep 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early — a refundable hold booked now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: December break destinations
needsAttention.detail: The holiday trip for all four girls (Dec 13–Jan 2) was due to be decided Sept 30, and booking closes in three days. A domestic shortlist is the clean default since passports land in November.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 window to move the car Portland → St Pete is now past the midpoint; the one hotel night still needs booking once the two drive dates are set.

needsAttention.title: Eugenia wants a date to talk
needsAttention.detail: She's back Oct 31 and asked you to pick a slot and put it in the calendar — you'd floated seeing her at ICGN in Toronto, so a proposed time would close it.

needsAttention.title: Mom's care paperwork
needsAttention.detail: Tampa Gardens still hasn't answered your Oct 7 note about the insurance form and updated plan of care — five days out, it's worth a nudge.

flagged.title: SVP Global Public Policy roles
flagged.detail: LinkedIn's alert surfaced a Senior VP of Global Public Policy listing and similar public-policy roles this morning.

flagged.title: Lunch with Fran, Fri 12:30
flagged.detail: She's fine with Miyake — a one-line reply locks the venue for Friday the 16th.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it's newsletters — NYT Cooking, WSJ, Ridgeline, Duolingo — and a couple of real-estate alerts.

resolved.title: Maine ferry tickets
resolved.detail: Confirmed this morning and forwarded to Mike — the Vinalhaven reservation is set.

recipe.why: Autumn apples are at their peak now, ripe for baking into something warm.

acts.line: The calendar is empty before noon — an open stretch with no handoffs to make.
Still nothing booked; the afternoon is yours to aim at whatever's been waiting.
Tomorrow opens with a 9 o'clock appointment, so an earlier night sits well.
